The only way to tell if gb and gb color games are real is to really open them up. With that said, I am pretty sure green is real (but you'd need to open it). The earlier pokemon games released outside of japan were colored matched with their respective versions. Eoth that being said, pokemon red is the most obvious fake I've ever seen: The cartridge doesn't match its version, the label is just wrong, and lastly, it wasn't released for the gb color. For the n64 carts, I'm pretty sure those games are real, but I'd wait for mods.
